newsitem.title: ESTONIA: KULMHOONE H1 PROFIT 5.587 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: KULMHOONE H1 PROFIT 5.587 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Estonian ice-cream producer Tallinna Kulmhoone had a gross profit of 5.587 million kroons in the first half of the year, it said on Monday.
It was 5.5 million kroons more than the same period last year, it added in a statement.
The good economic results were a result of successful sales, especially due to warm weather in June. It produced 1,150 tonnes of ice-cream, a rise of 64 percent compared to the same period last year.
According to an management estimate, it had 55 percent of the domestic ice-cream market at the end of June.
The company has increased its 1997 net profit estimate from six million kroons to eight million kroons. It increased its net turnover estimate from 60 million kroons to 75 million kroons.
